summary.text: Tim Gorsulowsky is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Patrick Ahrens (D).
He is a small business owner who owns a security services business and ran for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Tim Gorsulowsky grew up in Shreveport, Louisiana, and earned a bachelor's degree in business from East Texas Baptist University.
He moved to California in 1987 to work with his brother on a dermatology surgical practice.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he started a security services company in San Jose in 1994 that grew to 165 employees, and that he moved from Saratoga to Cupertino in 2017.
Gorsulowsky ran for California State Assembly District 26 in 2022, when incumbent Evan Low defeated him in the general election.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for the seat.
In the 2022 survey, he listed security and safety as a key campaign message and said he would seek to change California laws to give law enforcement more ability to charge criminals.
